notes: DCA said 104 prospective need; borough calculated 97; NJBA objected; mediation resulted in 99 (settlement April 15, 2025; ordered by court May 19, 2025). Present Need = 68 (rehabilitation program). Third Round RDP = 18; Combined Third + Fourth Round Unmet Need = 293. Fourth Round RDP = 0 (VLA-adjusted). Fourth Round Unmet Need = 99 addressed via: Leonia Retirement Housing surplus 29 credits + Fort Lee Road/north corridor Redevelopment Plan (approx 28 acres, 40-60 du/ac, 20% set-aside, potential 243 affordable units, Resolution 2023-71 Feb 6, 2023). Third Round RDP mechanisms: Sima Development (Block 802/Lot 16, 3 affordable + 3 bonus); J-ADD Group Home (Block 1205/Lot 25, 5 special needs + 2 bonus); Grandview Meadows extension (Block 802/Lot 6, 10 family); Leonia Retirement Housing (Block 901/Lot 7, 4 credits RDP + 77 unmet need); 100% Affordable Grand Ave (Block 1209/Lots 3&6, 4 rental + 2 for-sale proposed).

sources.title: Leonia Borough Third Round & Fourth Round Housing Element and Fair Share Plan (Adopted June 25, 2025; Amended June 2025)
sources.excerpt: The parties agreed to a prospective need obligation of 99 units. The Settlement Agreement was executed on April 15, 2025 by the Borough and NJBA... The Borough proposes to adopt a redevelopment plan for several areas within the Borough that were found to be in need of redevelopment (Resolution 2023-71 adopted on February 6, 2023). Approximately 28 acres will be included in the redevelopment plan and will permit multi-family dwellings as part of a mixed-use development on lots that are either located on Fort Lee Road or generally north of Fort Lee Road and west of Grand Avenue.

sites.quote: On December 13, 2022, the Borough Planning Board approved a 14-unit family rental project of which three (3) units will be deed restricted for low- and moderate-income individuals and families on Block 802, Lot 16 located at 131 Fort Lee Road.
sites.notes: 3 affordable units + 3 rental bonus credits = 6 total credits toward Third Round RDP.

sites.site_name: Grandview Meadows (392 Grand Avenue) - Extension of Controls
sites.adoption_status: existing (controls extended June 25, 2025 for 30 additional years)
sites.quote: Grandview Meadows is an existing development of ten (10) family condominium units located at 392 Grand Avenue (Block 802, Lot 6), which received prior cycle credits from the Council on Affordable Housing (COAH). The Borough will extend the expiring controls for a minimum of thirty (30) additional years beginning on June 25, 2025.
sites.notes: 10 family for-sale credits toward Third Round RDP.

sites.quote: This supportive and special needs home is located at 128 Palisade Avenue (Block 1205, Lot 25) and contains five (5) bedrooms for intellectually challenged individuals. J-ADD purchased the home in 1998 and the affordability controls are effective for 30 years as of August 31, 1999.
sites.notes: 5 supportive/special needs credits + 2 rental bonus credits = 7 total credits toward Third Round RDP.

sites.quote: This project, located at 270 Glenwood Avenue (Block 901, Lot 7) consists of two phases. The first phase includes 75 units... The second phase of the development includes 33 one-bedroom units... The Borough is claiming 4 age-restricted rental credits toward the RDP and 77 units toward the Unmet Need (Third Round 48 units (194 x 0.25) and Fourth Round 29 units (97 x 0.30).
sites.notes: 4 credits toward Third Round RDP + 77 credits toward Unmet Need (48 Third Round + 29 Fourth Round). 31 units surplus for future round. Total 108 senior rental units.

sites.developer: Borough-owned; non-profit developer to be selected
sites.quote: The Borough owns two (2) lots, Block 1209, Lots 3 (0.109 acres) and 6 (0.115 acres) located along the west side of Grand Avenue. The Borough will work with a non-profit developer to create one structure on each lot and provide for four (4) family rental units on Lot 6 and an attached single family for sale structure for two (2) families on Lot 3.
sites.notes: 4 family rental + 2 family for-sale = 6 affordable units toward Third Round RDP. Borough-owned land.

sites.quote: The Borough adopted Ordinance 2023-10 which implements an affordable housing overlay district (AH-2) on Block 1501, Lots 22, 23 and 24 located on Grand Avenue. The ordinance permits multi-family dwellings at a density of 27 units per acre. There is approximately one (1) acre of uplands on the parcel and with a 20% setaside of affordable housing required, a minimum of five (5) affordable housing units may be realized.
sites.notes: Third Round unmet need mechanism. 5 affordable units toward Third Round Unmet Need.

sites.site_name: Redevelopment Plan for Block 1213 Lots 3&4 (CPC Site — 266 Grand Avenue)
sites.adoption_status: AINR designated (Resolution 2022-107); redevelopment plan to be adopted
sites.quote: The Borough designated Block 1213, Lots 3 and 4 as an area in need of redevelopment (Resolution 2022-107 adopted on April 4, 2022) and will adopt a redevelopment plan to permit multi-family dwellings on the 0.98 acre parcel at a density of 20 dwelling units per acre with a required 20% setaside for affordable units.
sites.notes: 4 affordable units toward Third Round Unmet Need.

sites.site_name: Fort Lee Road / North Corridor Redevelopment Plan
sites.address: Fort Lee Road corridor and north of Fort Lee Road / west of Grand Avenue
sites.adoption_status: AINR designated; redevelopment plan to be adopted
sites.quote: The Borough proposes to adopt a redevelopment plan for several areas within the Borough that were found to be in need of redevelopment (Resolution 2023-71 adopted on February 6, 2023). Approximately 28 acres will be included in the redevelopment plan and will permit multi-family dwellings as part of a mixed-use development on lots that are either located on Fort Lee Road or generally north of Fort Lee Road and west of Grand Avenue. The proposed densities for the zoning district range from 40 to 60 dwelling units per acre and with a 20% setaside, the build out of the redevelopment zones may provide for the possibility of creating 243 affordable housing units.
sites.notes: Primary Fourth Round Unmet Need mechanism (99 units). Combined with Leonia Retirement Housing surplus (29 units), plan exceeds combined Third + Fourth Round Unmet Need of 291 units. No individual block/lots stated in HEFSP; ~28 acres.

sites.quote: Leonia Borough's rehabilitation obligation (present need) is 68 units. The rehabilitation obligation is not cumulative but is a recalculation based on the most recent census data. The Borough is addressing the 68-unit rehabilitation obligation through a municipally run rehabilitation program.
